title: The Long Way Home
route: Munich → Atlanta → DFW Airport → North Fort Worth
intro: After 24 days on the road, The Long Way Around comes to an end. The final journey begins at Munich Airport, crosses the Atlantic through Atlanta, continues to DFW Airport, and finishes with the drive home to North Fort Worth.

stops.name: Munich Airport
stops.description: Begin the journey home after the final night in Europe.

stops.name: Atlanta
stops.description: Return to the United States and connect in Atlanta for the final flight to DFW.

stops.name: DFW Airport
stops.description: Land back in North Texas before the final drive home.

stops.name: North Fort Worth
stops.description: Arrive home in North Fort Worth, completing The Long Way Around.
